Indonesia Seizes Chinese Ship with Missile Chemicals Bound for Bangladesh

Indonesian navy has seized a Chinese cargo ship bound for Bangladesh carrying 405 tons of sodium perchlorate, a chemical used in manufacturing rocket and missile propellants. The ship was also found to be carrying millions of unregistered SIM cards. Reports suggest the cargo originated from China and was destined for Bangladesh. The seizure has raised concerns and speculation about the potential use of the materials and a possible "China connection."
